payout_quote: Refer a friend or family member to open a Financial Plus checking account with direct deposit or new loan, and you both receive $50!* ... Once they open their account, setup their direct deposit, and accept their referral, you will both get $50 in your account within 30 business days. Remember, there is no limit on how many people you refer.
steps: Be a Financial Plus Credit Union member in good standing; click Refer-A-Friend on myfpcu.com and fill out the form.
Financial Plus sends an email to the person you referred; they open a new checking account with direct deposit (or a new loan over $10,000) and accept their referral.
The new member enrolls in direct deposit and E-Documents; both incentives are deposited within 30 business days after account opening, E-Document enrollment, and first direct deposit.
You receive $50 (your friend also gets $50); there is no limit on how many people you refer.
catches: Only new checking accounts or new loans over $10,000 qualify - no savings-only or small-loan referrals.
The new member must enroll in BOTH direct deposit and E-Documents, or neither party gets the $50.
Incentive for the referring member is reported on 1099-MISC; new member's on 1099-INT.
Cannot be combined with any other offer on the same product; Financial Plus can reject incentive redemptions and reserves the right to apply restrictions.
biggest_catch: The friend must open a new checking account with direct deposit (or a $10,000+ loan) AND enroll in E-Documents - miss either and nobody gets the $50.
eligibility: Financial Plus CU members in good standing; referred persons must open a new checking account with direct deposit or a new loan over $10,000.
timing: Both $50 incentives deposited within 30 business days after account opening, E-Document enrollment, and first direct deposit.
